branchName.instructions: Solo-contributor repo: the default is committing straight to `main`, no PR ceremony. Branch only for large or risky work; name it after the change's scope (e.g. bump-nixpkgs, agents-restructure) and land it on `main`.

commitMessage.instructions: `<area>: <imperative summary>` — e.g. "bootstrap.sh: use a generic example key name in the SSH prompt". Plain sentences, not Conventional Commits; no feat:/fix: prefixes or parenthesized scopes.

pullRequest.instructions: This repo does not use pull requests; changes land directly on `main`. If a description is ever needed, keep it to one paragraph: what changed and why.
